summary: Iteration 42 - Pulse Pro Portal Testing Complete. All features verified working. Backend: 15/15 tests passed. Frontend: All UI flows verified for both lite and pulse_pro users. Lite users see 5 tabs (Dashboard, Equipment, Log a Fault, Documents, Upgrade to Pro). Pulse Pro users see 7 tabs (Dashboard, Equipment, Log a Fault, Documents, Check Sheets, Reports, AI Diagnosis). Account type switching via Master Admin API works correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pulse Pro portal is fully functional. Test user (test@gymfixai.com) is currently set to account_type='lite'. To test pulse_pro features, use Master Admin to switch account type via PUT /api/master-admin/organizations/cb7ba17f-33f5-4aa2-94fe-8d94d2c679c9/account-type with body {"account_type":"pulse_pro"}.
